sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The league leaders come into this fixture in excellent form, unbeaten in their last five matches (W-D-W-W-W), and face an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and winless in their last five outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) travel to Dawley Town in a key fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach; Stafford's mixed recent form (D-W-W-L-W-D) contrasts with Dawley's more inconsistent record. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in what shapes as a competitive mid-table encounter, with Bridgnorth recovering from a recent loss but Eccleshall also rebuilding after a defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals, joint-fourth on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community in a fixture between similarly-ranked sides. Bilston Town (5th, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir (13th, 11 points) in a contest between a solid mid-table performer and a struggling side. Barnton host Shawbury United in a clash of inconsistent teams—Barnton mixing wins and draws while Shawbury endure a poor run of five straight losses. Telford Town, second-bottom with 6 points, visit Cheadle Heath Nomads in a basement-area battle between two struggling sides, while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town seeking to reverse recent form; both teams sit in the lower half. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture pitting 16th against 11th place, with both sides looking to climb the table. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's only pointless club, offering the hosts a chance to arrest their own recent mixed form.
